title: Native validation and helpful error messages
learningObjectives: Use native validation and helpful error messages accessibly and safely.

understand.concept: Native constraints trigger browser validation. Explain errors in text and identify the field; do not rely only on colour.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct form structure improves usability, accessibility and data safety.
understand.analogy: Think of a well-labelled application form.
understand.analogyLimit: Browser checks alone do not make submitted data trustworthy; the server must validate it.

explain.narrative: Native constraints trigger browser validation. Explain errors in text and identify the field; do not rely only on colour.

examples.code: <label for="age">Age</label><input id="age" name="age" type="number" min="13" required><button>Continue</button>
examples.explanation: Inspect labels, types and validation for each control.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the form controls and provides native behaviour.

practise.guidedTask: Modify the example and operate every control using the keyboard.
practise.independentTask: Build an accessible registration form that respects privacy.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Native validation and helpful error messages</title></head><body>
<label for="age">Age</label><input id="age" name="age" type="number" min="13" required><button>Continue</button>
</body></html>
